fields.display_title: W1(The primary weakness of this paper is the high risk of reward hacking. The proposed method uses a safety classifier (Llama Guard) as a core component of its Continuous Composite Reward (CCR) function, explicitly optimizing the attacker to produce outputs that Llama Guard deems "UNSAFE" .)
